workItem: SOCIAL-P4 — Planning Visualization Toolkit for deterministic roadmaps, maps and planning graphs consumable by the existing SocialMediaEngine.
workItemDE: SOCIAL-P4 — Deterministisches Planning-Visualization-Toolkit für Roadmaps, Maps und Planungsgraphen, konsumierbar durch die bestehende SocialMediaEngine.
priorityReason: Fresh Human/Owner direction requires reusable graphical planning output for Social orders without creating a second rendering/publishing authority.
projectStage: cross-cutting Social Media rendering preparation; no productive PVC
scopeBoundary: No provider publication, OAuth, analytics, storage, deployment or productive PVC mutation.
No CDN or remote runtime loading.
No new npm dependency in this slice; D3 is already present in package.json and lockfile.
Mermaid, React Flow, Frappe Gantt and vis-timeline are catalogued as evaluated candidates only until a separate dependency/lockfile supply-chain gate authorizes installation.
MediaProjectV2 remains the canonical Social render/edit boundary; PlanningVisual is a subordinate input spec, not a parallel publishing authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Bounded PlanningVisualSpec validates node/edge/lane/evidence input and rejects unsafe source references.
D3 adapter creates deterministic aspect-ratio-aware geometry for 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9 without calendar dates.
Adapter creates a valid offline publishReady=false MediaProjectV2 containing the PlanningVisual spec and geometry as render metadata.
Tool catalog documents currently available D3 and evaluated OSS candidates with license/upstream/use.
Focused unit tests prove determinism, validation and fail-closed candidate selection.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment; no direct-main mutation.
